title: Lisdonagh, Headford, Caherlistrane, Co. Galway, H91YE6T
seoTitle: Lisdonagh, Headford, Caherlistrane, Co. Galway, H91YE6T
description:
A beautifully restored traditional irish thatched cottage on Approximately 0.27 Acres.

Bluebell Cottage is a charming and authentic Irish thatched residence that successfully combines traditional character with modern comfort. Originally constructed in 1840 of traditional stone construction, this delightful home has been carefully maintained and sympathetically upgraded over the years, with the current owners making every effort to preserve its vernacular architectural style and unique heritage character.

Set on an attractive landscaped site. The property enjoys a peaceful rural setting while offering comfortable accommodation and a range of useful outbuildings. The cottage is complemented by several traditional stone outbuildings together with a detached garden room extending to approximately 25 sq. mtrs, providing excellent potential for a variety of uses including a home office, studio, hobby room or additional recreational space.

Accommodation:
The accommodation is both practical and inviting and comprises:
- Welcoming kitchen/dining room featuring a solid fuel stove.
- Utility room.
- Two ground-floor bathrooms.
- Three bedrooms, including two double bedrooms and one single bedroom.
- The cottage retains many traditional features, with timber flooring throughout. Significant attention has been paid to energy efficiency and comfort.

Features & Services
- Traditional stone-built thatched cottage dating from 1840.
- Sympathetically maintained and upgraded while retaining its original character.
- Rear extension with insulated galvanised roof covering.
- Detached garden room extending to approximately 25 sq.m.
- Collection of traditional stone outbuildings.
- Mains water supply.
- Electricity, telephone connection and fibre internet connection.
- Septic tank wastewater system.
- Oil-fired central heating.
- New combi condenser boiler installed in 2026.
- Solid fuel stove in kitchen/dining room.
- Timber floors throughout.
- two outdoor patio areas

A Rare Opportunity
Properties of this nature seldom come to the market. Bluebell Cottage offers purchasers a unique opportunity to acquire an authentic Irish thatched home that has been lovingly cared for and thoughtfully improved, while remaining true to its traditional roots. The property's blend of historic charm, practical accommodation, attractive outbuildings and peaceful countryside setting will appeal to those seeking a distinctive home full of character and warmth.
Bluebell Cottage represents a rare chance to own a piece of Ireland's architectural heritage in a sought-after location close to Headford and within convenient reach of Galway City, Lough Corrib and the many amenities of the surrounding area.
